- Description updated with a specific 'Notes' catagory so you can have a general description about what the entry is and specific notes about your personal thoughts about the entry.
- Autocomplete added, now auto suggests previous entries data such as previously used genres, authors, artists, actresses etc.
- When Exporting can now choose a zip file, including your json export alongside the folder with all images you have used in the app for use elsewhere or to reimport into the app another time.

QoL Improvements:
- Collections now allow you to add multiple items at once. Previously was one at a time, now upgraded to a multi select picker.
- When making an 'award year' it now creates the year and saves it even without any award catagories added. Before it only created the 'year' if there was catagories.

Bug Fixes:
- Backup/import now exports/imports notes and is_completed status correctly.
- Missing cover art now falls back to a bundled local asset instead of a remote placeholder. The new asset lives at cover-fallback.svg.

Performance Optimizations:
- Routes are now lazy-loaded in App.tsx, so pages are split into separate chunks instead of being pulled into one large app bundle.
- Search is now DB-backed instead of loading the whole library into memory.

releases.title: Media Logger 2.9
releases.body:
This is a update fully focused on cleanup. Added so much and big changes over recent updates, so focused on bug fixing and QOL for this one.

New Features:
- Dynamic years with Settings management (no hard-coded year lists in nav/stats anymore), with backward compatibility fallback for existing users.

Quality of Life:
- Dashboard's featured entry is now truly 100% random no weighting or anything now.
- Dashboard 2025 links removed; quick links now resolve dynamically from available/recent years.
- Light-mode QoL improved by removing key hard-coded dark assumptions in layout, honouring system mode fallback, and adding light-mode compatibility overrides for common dark-biased utility classes.
- Backup/import now includes profiles mappings so personalisation is portable.

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed schema/query key mismatch for collections and awards by standardising on media_id in base schema and adding compatibility migrations that rebuild legacy tables using entry_id/added_date/old winner shapes into the new format.
- Added missing created_date support for award_categories in both fresh schema and migration path (including backfill for existing rows).
- Added creation of the profiles table for clean installs, so profile reads/writes no longer fail on new DBs.
- Rewrote CSV import parsing to handle quoted multiline fields correctly by tokenising full CSV rows with quote-state tracking instead of splitting on newline first.
- Added missing modal style classes used by the Settings import result modal (modal-overlay, modal-content) so styling/behaviour is now defined and stable.

Performance Improvements:
- Replaced expensive ORDER BY RANDOM() featured-entry query with a two-step random offset strategy
- Removed N+1 in collections & awards. Thumbnail candidates now loaded in one query and grouped in memory (first 4 per collection).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Intelios/Media-Logger/compare/2.8...2.9.0

releases.title: Media Logger 2.1
releases.body:

- Stats are now organized into dropdown sections to provide deeper insights without cluttering the interface.

- Fixed an issue where long descriptions could be cut off in Year View. Descriptions now properly support larger amounts of text, ensuring all information remains accessible.

- Added a “View Image” option to the Year View entry dropdown, allowing full-size images to be viewed for any entry.

- Genre overflow indicators (e.g. “+2”) now display the remaining genres in a hover popup, making all genres easily visible.

- Fixed an issue where multiple actresses were displayed as a single combined tag; actresses now appear as separate, individual tags.

- Fixed an issue where the selected stats filter did not persist; filter selections now remain saved after reloads or reboots.

- Improved readability of stats tooltips by fixing text contrast issues (previously black text on dark backgrounds).

- Fixed the Add Entry button in the left panel, which previously did not function. Both add entry buttons now work as expected.

- Hovering over the Rewatch and Local Copy icons now displays tooltips explaining their meaning, improving clarity for new users.

- Fixed an issue in Collections & Search where selecting Edit from an entry’s dropdown menu had no effect.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Intelios/Media-Logger/compare/2.0...2.1

releases.title: Media Logger 2.0 / V20
releases.body:
This is an entire project remake from Python & Flet into Tauri + React + TypeScript. Completely rebuilt from the ground up with a new UI design, new features and backward compatibility. The same assets/images & .db file will work on both Python & Tauri versions.

Going forward it will be Media Logger 2.0 > 2.1 and so on. The Python era has ended, though is preserved through a legacy branch on the repo, swap to it and any time with all updates up to V19 (and a small 2026 update I did not turn into it's own release)

- Entirely rebuilt from the ground up in Tauri
- Same year view, stats, profiles, search, collections, awards are all functioning
- Everything works almost entirely the same as it did in the Flet/Python version.

- For new additions:
- Customisable data path, can store your .db/Images folder anywhere now
- Completely new UI design language
- A icon for the app no longer using default Flet/Tauri
- Now a standalone app file provided no longer needing to just run the raw 'main.py' just run the app
- Uses less RAM about 10-20% on average
- Image loading is faster and more system resource efficient. 
- And so much more stuff behind the scenes changed, it's a more modern, better designed and modular app compared to the Python version. Taken a ton of work but it's here.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Intelios/Media-Logger/compare/v19...2.0
